canonical_nse_universe.rationale: Listings have historical valid_from/valid_to fields but no independently qualified historical dissemination clock. Current identities are never back-projected before their persisted creation time.

financials.rationale: Historical filings downloaded later remain unknown before observed retrieval availability.

prices.rationale: Trading date is economic time; the accepted archive does not backdate knowledge time to market close.

benchmark.rationale: Index date is economic time and observed retrieval availability remains authoritative.

delivery.rationale: Historical delivery artifacts fetched later are current-research evidence only after retrieval.

corporate_actions.rationale: Ex-date and record date do not replace the observed knowledge clock.

business_events.rationale: Announcement timestamps are not adopted as historical knowledge time in the accepted ingestion policy.

news_attention.rationale: Only successfully archived aggregate responses are visible after observed retrieval.

market_cap.rationale: No security-level market-cap source or derivation is approved.
